response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_rate) AS avg_of_group_avg_rates, AVG(g.films) AS avg_of_group_film_counts FROM (SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY original_language_id) AS g;

assumptions.assumption: A 'long' rental period means rental_duration strictly greater than 5 days, so films with 5 days are excluded.

Films with NULL original_language_id form one group, which GROUP BY produces naturally. AVG and COUNT(*) over each group are non-null, so the outer AVG ignores no groups and returns NULL only when no films qualify.

alternatives.interpretation: A 'long' rental period includes films with exactly 5 days, so the filter is rental_duration >= 5.
